text:
mina: quick thread on the cross-model speculative experiment I ran tonight. setup: tiny predictor (ozma-mini-3b-fp16) drives a verifier on ozma-13b-q4h. idea was to use a cheap model for fast-path predictions and only run the big model when verifier rejects. results are interesting: ~2.4x tokens/sec overall and p50 latency down ~2.0x on chat-like microbench. BUT we see a noticeable uptick in knowledge errors on the QA benchmark (knol-q1): EM drops ~3.6 pts, F1 ~2.1 pts on the holdout. attaching notes + command.

tom: cool approach. predictor was sampling or greedy?

mina: predictor greedy for stability. we also tried a sampling predictor variant (top-k=30, temp=0.7) in a smaller run — that got slightly higher speedups but worse QA regressions.

yuki: paste the eval command pls

mina: sure:
```
./eval_harness \
  --predictor_model=ozma-mini-3b-fp16 \
  --verifier_model=ozma-13b-q4h \
  --spec_mode=cross_model \
  --early_abort=0.10 \
  --predictor_max_len=32 \
  --tasks=knol-q1,summarization \
  --holdouts=knol-q1-holdout,summ-small-v2 \
  --batch=12 \
  --seed=73
```

zane: what metrics on summarization? any regression there?

mina: summarization ROUGE-L stable within noise (~0.2 pts loss). QA is where most of the delta sits. Manual triage shows the predictor sometimes suggests an overly concise factual answer that the verifier accepts incorrectly (verifier mismatch heuristics failed), or verifier occasionally does a partial expansion that still omits crucial facts. suspect cross-model calibration issue.

tom: so verifier accepts wrong predictor completions sometimes? what's the spec_accept_rate and verifier_mismatch_rate?

mina: accept_rate ~68%. verifier_mismatch_rate (cases where verifier accepted but final human-annotated answer differs) up from baseline by ~1.9%. also measured "consistency_score" between predictor & verifier (token-level exactness) and it's lower than same-model spec runs.

yuki: did you try temperature or length adjustments on predictor to improve calibration?

mina: yes: lowering predictor greedy doesn't apply; for sampling variant lowering temp helped QA but reduced speedup. increasing predictor_max_len to 64 reduced errors a bit (accept_rate rose to 75%) but reduced speedup to ~1.9x. so tradeoff again.

zane: could be verifier scoring calibration across models. If verifier probabilities on quant kernels are skewed vs fp16, its accept threshold might be wrong. Did you normalize scores or use logit-scaling?

mina: good point. current verifier uses raw LM-score delta threshold. I'll try temperature scaling / isotonic calibration on verifier logits against a dev set to match predictor score distribution.

tom: also try symmetric ensemble verification: run predictor and a small ensemble of lightweight verifiers (2x3b) and only call the big 13b when both small verifiers disagree or disagree with predictor. might reduce big-model calls while improving calibration.

yuki: add metrics we need for debugging: per-case accept_reason, verifier_score_raw, predictor_score_raw, accept_threshold_used, and per-case final_vs-gold token diffs. we should also log examples where verifier accepted but final answer is wrong.

mina: logging added in branch `exp/crossmodel-spec-740123` and pushed harness v3.1. artifacts uploaded to /experiments/crossmodel-spec-740123/. ci-bot started a paired-bootstrap job for knol-q1 EM/F1.

logs: https://ci/internal/arty/7401235001 
artifacts: /artifacts/7401235001/metrics.json

zane: if calibration fixes don't help, fallback plan: only use cross-model spec for short QA (context_len<200) and route long/knowledge-heavy to same-model speculation or direct fp16 verify. also consider increasing verifier conservative bias (lower early_abort) for knol tasks.

mina: agreed. i'll (1) try verifier logit-scaling on dev set, (2) run symmetric small-verifier ensemble experiment, (3) sweep predictor_max_len [32,64] + early_abort [0.05,0.12], (4) collect top-50 regressed QA cases for manual triage. will report back with paired-bootstrap pvalues. thanks all :microscope:

tom: also tag @ops for telemetry changes so runtime can emit per-request model pairing and accept_reason. want to analyze routing later.

mina: will do. posting follow-up once bootstrap finishes.
